messages:
deploy-bot: heads-up: scheduling a soft-unpin for model-group 'q-lite' in canary on 2024-03-17 02:00 UTC. Reason: kernel mismatch causing rare latency spikes. Will route traffic to q-compat when triggered.

marta: ack. what rollback signal should we use if spikes > 250ms p95 for 10m?

ravi: +1 to that threshold. also watch error-rate on kv-cache misses, last time that correlated.

jen-docs: can we add a one-liner to release notes and the troubleshooting doc before the window? I can push a short note saying "expected transient p95 increases in canary; fallback to q-compat".

aaron: FYI the SDK 2.8.1 adds a header check that can cause client rejects when runtime returns a legacy content-type. Not blocking but worth calling out. Might need a QA smoke against SDK clients.

marta: good catch @aaron — we'll include an SDK compatibility test in the canary checklist. @tim-oncall can you stand by for the 02:00 UTC window?

tim-oncall: I can be on-call for rollout. I'll monitor p95, 5xx rate, and deploy-bot alerts. If p95>250ms for 10m or 5xx delta >0.5% over baseline: issue rollback and post status.

ci-bot: ci-pipeline: canary-smoke-tests passed on node-set-a.

deploy-bot: rolling window: 2024-03-17T02:00:00Z -> 2024-03-17T04:00:00Z. Commands: `/deploy pinlist remove q-lite --target=canary` then `/deploy rollout model q-lite v2.1.3 -> q-compat v2.1.0 fallback-enabled`.

ravi: adding a telemetry tag `staged_unpin_q-lite_2024-03-17` so we can slice metrics. Also enabling detailed traces for kv-cache for 30m post-unpin.

jen-docs: drafted release note snippet and short FAQ. Posting PR: docs#4127 — please review quick.

aaron: ran quick client smoke locally against canary with SDK 2.8.1 — header warning logged but request still accepted. Recommend we add a warning line in SDK changelog.

marta: decision: proceed with soft-unpin in canary with rollback thresholds above. If stable for 30m after rollout (p95 steady <180ms, 5xx within baseline), we'll schedule regional stagger starting 06:00 UTC.

tim-oncall: I'll wire an alert dashboard and set a PagerDuty temporary rule.

deploy-bot: note: automated rollback will flip to q-compat and mark canary as 'pinback'. Manual rollback command: `/deploy rollback model q-lite --to=q-compat --reason=latency-regression`.

jen-docs: PR posted and linked from release notes. Also adding a customer-facing blurb for the status page in case we need to communicate.

marta: thanks all. After the window, leave a short post with final telemetry and whether the SDK changelog entry was merged.

aaron: will open SDK changelog PR after docs PR merges.

ravi: one more: if kv-cache miss rate spikes >3x baseline, escalate immediately even if p95 is marginal. That correlated with CPU spikes last time.

marta: noted. tagging that in the runbook. good work. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: deploy-checklist: docs PR linked, SDK smoke ✅, canary-smoke ✅, telemetry tag applied. Ready for window.
